# The Agentic Platformfor Enterprise Systems

One intelligence layer for the people who build the system and the people who run the business on it.

Talk to Sales ↗

IN PRODUCTION

## Working 24/7 for the teams at

Rebuilding decades of custom code for Clean Core at 5x productivity↗

Compressing multi-year consolidation programs while closing security and governance gaps

Federating legacy systems into one global platform, cutting incident analysis from hours to minutes

Streamlining factory-critical processes and accelerating fulfillment of business requests↗

Higher capacity3x

Increase in productivity across all tasks

Lower project cost50%

Reduction in transformation & operational costs

Improved production quality8x

Efficiency in preempting and resolving issues

## Autonomous

Works independently end-to-end. Plans, executes, and self-corrects errors, coming to your team only for review, decisions, or approval.

## Generally Capable

Primed from day one with built-in guided workflows and best practices. Extensible across your full ERP system and integrates with your toolchain.

## Adaptable

Learns your environments and calibrates to your standards, so every task fuels an evolving knowledge core and the platform improves with every use.

## Proactive

Monitors your systems and business processes for issues and opportunities — and automatically implements optimizations.

01

## Discover

### Understand your system as well as the people who built it.

Nova reads your whole landscape — processes, custom code, integrations — keeps documentation current, and answers any question about how your system works.

02

## Design

### Decide what to build. And how.

Nova architects the solution — deciding what to build, and the best way to build it.

03

## Build

### Ship Clean-Core, cloud-ready extensions 3x faster.

Nova writes code changes to the system, makes them run, and tests them — Clean-Core first and with enterprise-grade controls — turning specs into working software, not just a draft you have to finish.

04

## Operate

### Fix problems before the business feels them.

Nova traces root causes, triages tickets, and ships fixes to keep your live system running on an always-current understanding of how it all connects.

> “Our team estimates they are more than 5x more productive on average across all tasks. That level of capacity increase completely changes the game for our organization.”

Read the case study

Jörn Weigle, CIO at Festo
